title: Experiential vs Simulated Learning
location: JW Marriott Indianapolis, IN · White River Ballroom F
description: Scheduled for 1:00–2:00 pm. Laura Shackelford, Sepehr Vaez Afshar, and Sarvin Eshaghi join Lena Currie and Melissa Roth of SGH to explore teaching preservation diagnostics and skills through hands-on experiences and realistic simulations. Following introductions from industry and academic presenters, attendees are invited to try non-destructive testing and virtual reality equipment.
